title: Gate Windows composite signatures by the exact algorithm
goal: Require the agreed composite signature parameter set when signing Windows bulletins; reject unavailable algorithms without substituting a different signature contract.

selectionNotes: Require the agreed composite signature parameter set when signing Windows bulletins; reject unavailable algorithms without substituting a different signature contract.
Exact RC evidence does not establish final GA verification.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: Execute the selected framework contracts; exact runtime artifacts are separate verification baselines.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build against the .NET 11 reference assemblies; exact RC2 is the recorded test baseline.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Canonical sample language mode; no experimental language feature is required.

providers: Windows CNG provider supporting the exact agreed CompositeMLDsaAlgorithm
platforms: Windows with measured exact-algorithm support; ordinary OS version alone is insufficient
prerequisites: Workload-free net11.0 console project; ImplicitUsings and Nullable enabled; namespace Observatory; canonical helpers in separate files.
constraints: No algorithm substitution or classical-only fallback; peer agreement includes parameter set, public key and exact payload bytes.
No Windows composite certificate support is claimed. Probe results do not prove successful operations.
optIns: Explicit SYSLIB5006 opt-in in the sample project; no blanket warning suppression
stabilityLimitations: Experimental SYSLIB5006; API/provider contract may change. Actual GA reconciliation remains open.

evidence.scope: Actual .NET10 Windows support probes, 44/P256 sign/verify/tamper rejection and managed RSA2048/PSS sign/verify/tamper success. Exact native/compiler/reference/runtime hashes retained. No other ECDSA set, certificate or GA claim.

Actual .NET11RC2 Windows support probes, native44/P256 sign/verify/tamper rejection and unsupported RSA2048/PSS failure. Exact native/compiler/reference/runtime hashes retained. No other ECDSA set, certificate or GA claim.

humanProof.scope: Actual local Windows provider and managed checks require no interactive approval; no production keys, trust stores or data touched.
